extraction_notes: Fig. 3 provides a usable FR101W-FR107W typical forward-voltage curve. The fourteen points are direct observations from the supplied plot at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle; no intermediate points were synthesized.

Fig. 4 provides usable typical reverse-characteristic curves for Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. The eight points on each curve are direct observations, with reverse current represented as a positive magnitude on the plotted microampere axis; no intermediate points were synthesized.
For FR107W, the absolute maximum ratings are VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, and IFSM = 30.0 A at Ta = 25 degC. These are operating limits and are not breakdown data.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF = 1.3 V at IF = 1.0 A, maximum Trr = 500 ns for FR107W at IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, and Irr = 0.25 A, maximum IR1 = 2.0 microampere at VR = VDC and Ta = 25 degC, maximum IR2 = 200 microampere at Ta = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 9 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. The high-temperature IR2 row is preserved in this note but is not used as the DC fit target.
The supplied datasheet publishes no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC are rating limits only.
